content: I'll read the test image first to analyze the visual symptoms.

The test image shows a sugarcane leaf with a prominent yellowish/pale linear streak running along the upper margin of the leaf. The leaf is predominantly green with this distinct streak pattern — linear discoloration rather than spots or diffuse yellowing.

Key features noted:
- Linear/streaky yellowing along the leaf
- Green background tissue largely intact
- Streak appears to run parallel to the leaf veins

This pattern is most consistent with **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv** or **Yellow_Leaf**. Let me view a reference for Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv to confirm.

**Analysis comparison:**

The **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv** reference shows fine, multiple pale/light-green streaks distributed subtly across the entire leaf surface — this doesn't strongly match the test image.

The **test image** shows:
- One prominent, wide pale-yellow/cream colored streak running along the upper leaf margin
- The streak is isolated and linear, running parallel to the veins
- The rest of the leaf blade is healthy dark green

This single prominent stripe along the margin is more characteristic of **Leaf_Scald**, which produces white to straw-colored pencil-line to wide stripes running from leaf margins toward the midrib, parallel to the veins. Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv typically shows fine multiple streaks distributed across the whole leaf, not a single marginal stripe.

Yellow_Leaf would show more diffuse whole-leaf yellowing (especially midrib). Brown_Spot and Yellow_Spot would show discrete lesions, not linear streaks. Pokkah_Boeng typically involves distorted/twisted leaves.
